name: frost iron
lore_descriptor: pale blue-white iron that frosts the air around it
first_pickup_chronicle: Frost iron. Quenched not in water but in a glacier's heart. It carries the cold with it. Fire-things will feel this before they see it.
design_notes: Chain combat v2 tuning: damage_mult 1.15, weight_mult 1.00, effective_against fire creatures + salamanders (T3 elemental, rare drop). Themed rare-of-the-tier — visual/generation cue only; no flat elemental damage per doc §Elemental effect.
